verdict.rationale: Raygun has an in-product AI chat for error resolution, so it is fair to ask whether that assistant can consume external MCP servers. The evidence pack never documents MCP-client support. The only MCP evidence is Raygun's own MCP server (raygun-probe-3), which is the server role and does not transfer to this client-side story; the OpenAI key configuration is an LLM setting, not MCP tool plug-in.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
